what: Nearest-neighbour value function. TRAINED on MEW self-play, EVALUATED on held-out clean human games, per docs/POKER-TO-POKEMON.md section 7: self-play is the training signal, human games are the calibration set and never the training signal.
caveat: Self-play positions come from MAG playing itself. If MAG's play is unlike human play the neighbourhoods are unrepresentative and the lookup is confidently wrong; that is why the evaluation set is HUMAN. A large gap between self-play holdout and human holdout would be distribution shift, and the human number is the one to trust.
